short.bs: Sočni biskvit, krema od pistacije i kiselkasti fil od malina.
short.en: Moist sponge, pistachio cream and a tangy raspberry layer.

description.bs: Naša najtraženija torta. Mekani vanilin biskvit natopljen mlijekom, bogata krema od prave pistacijine paste i slojevi domaćeg fila od malina koji razbija slatkoću. Svaki komad ima onaj savršeni balans — kremasto, orašasto i blago kiselkasto. Ukrašava se mljevenom pistacijom i svježim malinama.
description.en: Our most-loved cake. A soft vanilla sponge soaked in milk, a rich cream made with real pistachio paste and layers of homemade raspberry filling that cuts through the sweetness. Every slice has that perfect balance — creamy, nutty and gently tart. Finished with ground pistachios and fresh raspberries.

short.bs: Hrskava podloga, mousse od bijele čokolade, malina i pistacija glazura.
short.en: Crisp base, white chocolate mousse, raspberry and a pistachio glaze.

description.bs: Kolač za kojim se poseže dva puta. Na hrskavoj podlozi od badema slažemo žele od malina, laganu kremu od bijele čokolade i završavamo sjajnom glazurom od pistacije. Reže se na uredne kocke — idealno za slavlja, posjete i kafu s prijateljicama.
description.en: The slice everyone goes back for. A crisp almond base topped with raspberry jelly, a light white chocolate cream and a glossy pistachio glaze. Cut into neat squares — perfect for parties, guests and coffee with friends.

short.bs: Čokoladni biskvit s bademom, fil od malina i vanilin krema.
short.en: Chocolate almond sponge, raspberry filling and vanilla cream.

description.bs: Tamni, sočni biskvit s mljevenim bademima, debeo sloj fila od malina, svilenkasta vanilin krema i preliv od tamne čokolade. Klasik koji podsjeća na kolače iz bakine kuhinje, samo malo moderniji.
description.en: A dark, moist sponge made with ground almonds, a generous layer of raspberry filling, silky vanilla cream and a dark chocolate topping. A classic that tastes like grandma's kitchen — just a little more modern.

short.bs: Kore od bjelanaca i oraha, krema od pistacije i tanki sloj maline.
short.en: Meringue-nut layers, pistachio cream and a thin raspberry layer.

description.bs: Naš twist na legendarnu Esterházy tortu. Tanke kore od bjelanaca i pečenih oraha, nježna krema od pistacije i tanak sloj fila od malina. Gornji dio je ukrašen tradicionalnim 'paukovim' uzorkom od bijele čokolade i pistacije.
description.en: Our twist on the legendary Esterházy torte. Thin meringue layers with toasted walnuts, a delicate pistachio cream and a thin layer of raspberry filling. The top is finished with the classic feathered pattern in white chocolate and pistachio.

short.bs: Tradicionalni kolačići punjeni kremom od oraha i čokolade.
short.en: Traditional cookies filled with a walnut and chocolate cream.

description.bs: Kolačići koji izgledaju kao prave breskve — mekane polutke pune kreme od oraha i čokolade, umočene u ružičasti i žuti sok i uvaljane u šećer. Neizostavni na svakoj svadbi, rođendanu i bajramskom stolu.
description.en: Little cookies that look just like real peaches — soft halves filled with a walnut and chocolate cream, dipped in pink and yellow syrup and rolled in sugar. A must at every wedding, birthday and holiday table.

short.bs: Kolač bez pečenja od čokolade i keksa, s pistacijom na vrhu.
short.en: No-bake chocolate and biscuit log, topped with pistachio.

description.bs: Omiljeni kolač bez pečenja: kremasta mliječna čokolada, puter i komadi keksa oblikovani u rolat, preliveni čokoladom od pistacije i posuti sjeckanim pistacijama. Reže se na kriške debljine prsta.
description.en: A favourite no-bake treat: creamy milk chocolate, butter and chunks of biscuit shaped into a log, drizzled with pistachio chocolate and sprinkled with chopped pistachios. Sliced finger-thick.

short.bs: Vanilin biskvit, krem sir i šlag, kompot od malina.
short.en: Vanilla sponge, cream cheese whip and raspberry compote.

description.bs: Lagana, osvježavajuća torta za ljubitelje voćnih okusa. Tri sloja zračnog vanilin biskvita, krema od krem sira i šlaga te gusti kompot od malina koji se vidi u svakom presjeku. Spolja je ukrašena nježnom ružičastom kremom.
description.en: A light, refreshing cake for fruit lovers. Three layers of airy vanilla sponge, a cream cheese and whipped cream filling and a thick raspberry compote that shows in every slice. Finished outside with a soft pink cream.

short.bs: Kore od oraha, slana karamela i krema od mascarponea.
short.en: Walnut layers, salted caramel and mascarpone cream.

description.bs: Za one koji vole bogate, orašaste okuse. Tanke kore od pečenih oraha, domaća slana karamela i krema od mascarponea s notom vanilije. Svaki zalogaj je mekan, a opet ima hrskavost oraha.
description.en: For lovers of rich, nutty flavours. Thin layers baked with toasted walnuts, homemade salted caramel and a mascarpone cream with a hint of vanilla. Soft in every bite, with the crunch of walnuts.

short.bs: Slojevi plazma kreme, čokolade i šlaga na podlozi od keksa.
short.en: Layers of Plazma biscuit cream, chocolate and whipped cream.

description.bs: Torta s okusom djetinjstva. Kremasta vanilin krema s mljevenom Plazmom, sloj čokoladne kreme i lagani šlag na hrskavoj podlozi od keksa. Djeca je obožavaju, a odrasli uvijek traže još jedan komad.
description.en: A cake that tastes like childhood. Creamy vanilla filling with ground Plazma biscuits, a chocolate cream layer and light whipped cream on a crunchy biscuit base. Kids adore it — and grown-ups always ask for another slice.

short.bs: Kore od lješnjaka, ganache od bijele čokolade i nugat krema.
short.en: Hazelnut layers, white chocolate ganache and nougat cream.

description.bs: Elegantna torta za posebne prilike. Kore od prženih lješnjaka, svilenkasti ganache od bijele čokolade i krema od nugata, obložena bijelom kremom s teksturom. Izgleda nježno, a okus je pun i bogat.
description.en: An elegant cake for special occasions. Toasted hazelnut layers, a silky white chocolate ganache and a nougat cream, covered in textured white frosting. It looks delicate, but the flavour is full and rich.

short.bs: Kakao biskvit, mousse od tamne i mliječne čokolade.
short.en: Cocoa sponge with dark and milk chocolate mousse.

description.bs: Za prave čokoholičare. Vlažni kakao biskvit u više tankih slojeva, mousse od tamne čokolade i krema od mliječne čokolade. Intenzivno, ali ne preslatko — savršeno uz crnu kafu.
description.en: For true chocoholics. A moist cocoa sponge in several thin layers, dark chocolate mousse and milk chocolate cream. Intense but not too sweet — perfect with a black coffee.

short.bs: Mini deserti u čašicama: keks, malina, vanilija i pistacija.
short.en: Mini desserts in cups: biscuit, raspberry, vanilla and pistachio.

description.bs: Elegantni deserti u pojedinačnim čašicama — idealni za švedske stolove, krštenja i proslave. Sloj mrvljenog keksa, fil od malina, vanilin krema i krema od pistacije, ukrašeno cijelim pistacijama. Bez rezanja, bez mrvljenja.
description.en: Elegant individual desserts in cups — ideal for buffets, christenings and parties. A layer of crumbled biscuit, raspberry filling, vanilla cream and pistachio cream, topped with whole pistachios. No cutting, no mess.

short.bs: Mekane rolnice s cimetom i smeđim šećerom, prelivene vanilija kremom.
short.en: Soft rolls with cinnamon and brown sugar, topped with vanilla cream.

description.bs: Mirisne, mekane kao pamuk. Dizano tijesto s puterom, punjeno cimetom i smeđim šećerom, pečeno zajedno u tepsiji i bogato preliveno toplom vanilija kremom. Najbolje kad se jedu još mlake.
description.en: Fragrant and soft as a cloud. Buttery yeast dough filled with cinnamon and brown sugar, baked together in a tray and generously covered with warm vanilla cream. Best eaten while still warm.

short.bs: Tanko razvučene kore punjene vanilin kremom, prelivene mlijekom.
short.en: Paper-thin pastry filled with vanilla cream and soaked in milk.

description.bs: Domaća savijača od tanko razvučenih kora, punjena kremom od griza i vanilije, pečena do zlatne boje i prelivena slatkim mlijekom dok je još topla. Posipa se šećerom u prahu. Ukus nedjeljnog ručka kod nane.
description.en: Homemade strudel with hand-stretched pastry, filled with a semolina vanilla cream, baked golden and soaked in sweet milk while still warm. Dusted with icing sugar. Tastes like Sunday lunch at grandma's.

short.bs: Bijeli volani od kreme, bordo mašne i zlatni detalji.
short.en: White cream ruffles, burgundy bows and gold details.

description.bs: Romantična torta za rođendane, godišnjice i zaruke. Spolja ručno rađeni volani od kreme, satenske mašne i perlice; unutra okus po vašem izboru. Natpis i boje mašni prilagođavamo vašoj proslavi.
description.en: A romantic cake for birthdays, anniversaries and engagements. Hand-piped cream ruffles, satin bows and pearls outside; your choice of flavour inside. We match the inscription and ribbon colours to your celebration.

short.bs: Ružičasta torta s mjesecom, oblačićima i zlatnim kuglicama.
short.en: Pink cake with a moon, little clouds and gold spheres.

description.bs: Nježna torta za bebe, prve rođendane i baby shower. Mjesec od bijele čokolade, šećerni oblačići, zvjezdice i kuglice u zlatnoj i ružičastoj boji. Boje prilagođavamo — ružičasto, plavo ili neutralno.
description.en: A sweet cake for babies, first birthdays and baby showers. A white chocolate moon, sugar clouds, little stars and spheres in gold and pink. We can adapt the colours — pink, blue or neutral.

short.bs: Tematska torta s figurom motora i trkaćim zastavicama.
short.en: Themed cake with a racing bike figure and chequered flags.

description.bs: Za male (i velike) ljubitelje brzine. Ombre krema u plavim tonovima, figura motora, trkaće zastavice i broj godina. Tema, boje i figura se mogu prilagoditi — auto, fudbal, crtani junaci…
description.en: For little (and big) speed lovers. Ombré cream in shades of blue, a racing bike figure, chequered flags and the birthday number. Theme, colours and figure can be changed — cars, football, cartoon heroes…

short.bs: Dva sprata, cvjetići od kreme i velika mašna od organdija.
short.en: Two tiers, piped cream blossoms and a big organza bow.

description.bs: Torta koja je centar proslave. Donji sprat u bijeloj, gornji u ružičastoj boji, ukrašeni cvjetićima od kreme i velikom mašnom od organdija. Idealna za drugi rođendan, krštenje ili akiku. Svaki sprat može biti drugog okusa.
description.en: The cake that becomes the centrepiece. A white bottom tier and a pink top tier, decorated with piped cream blossoms and a large organza bow. Ideal for a second birthday, christening or aqiqah. Each tier can be a different flavour.
